commits.subject: feat(strategy): tail policy — exact E[season-best] once 57 is unreachable
commits.body:
On 9/03 the contest streak was 0 with 25 game dates left. The reach-57 solver
values every action at exactly 0.0 once streak + 2*days < 57, argmax falls to
index 0 = skip, and production would have idled through 9/27.

Owner requirement: keep picking for the season-best streak; stop only once the
best can no longer be beaten.

- bts.simulate.tail_policy: mdp_objective (regime from state alone, exact
  within the MDP model), solve_emax_season_best (port of the validated audit
  solver on state (streak, best, days, saver); explicit stop rule
  skip iff min(57, s+2d) <= best; play-first ties), a separate versioned
  artifact data/models/mdp_tail_policy.npz with an exhaustive loader bound to
  the base policy's sha256, forced_tail_action for every failure shape.
- strategy.resolve_policy_decision produces ONE PolicyDecision (objective,
  best trust, effective best, tail sha, degraded reason) reused by logs, skip
  DM/dashboard, both EOD skip captures, the commit writer, decision.json v3.
  A missing/corrupt base policy can no longer reach the 0.80 heuristic in the
  tail (Codex r2 P0).
- contest_state.classify_best_streak: only a trusted best (auto fetch or
  unexpired manual, current season, streak <= best <= 57) may stop the account;
  untrusted/missing degrade to best = streak and keep picking.
- daily_decision v3; skip-policy shadow + boundary census admit reach57 only;
  mdp_policy_alignment excludes tail days; new tail_policy health source
  (always-attention); pick provenance tail_policy_sha256.
- scripts/rebuild_tail_policy.py: late-season, production-shaped
  (different-game) rates, one bin (p_hit 2641/3600, p_both 1984/3600).
- Tests: solver vs hand values + audit solver; stop-rule partition over every
  consulted cell; regime/fallback/trust/clamps; loader isolation; scheduler
  capture + writers; committed-artifact contract test.

Design reviewed twice by Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) before code, once after (r3: 7 findings fixed —
decision persisted on the pick, trust by contents, unverifiable-tail fallback, exact
re-solve validation, single-read loader, strict v3 objective, census samples); the
frontier-extraction shortcut was rejected with exact counterexamples. See
docs/audit/2026-09-03-emax-tail-policy.md (+ archived Codex rounds).
